WhatsApp is free 2 and offers simple, secure, reliable messaging and calling, available on phones all over the world. 1 And yes, the name WhatsApp is a pun on the phrase What's Up. 2 Data charges may apply. Our Mission WhatsApp started as an alternative to SMS. Our product now supports sending and receiving a variety of media: text, photos, videos, documents, and location, as well as voice calls. It’s free*, private, and has the features you need to make conversations easier and more productive. * Data charges may apply. Contact your provider for details. WhatsApp group messaging brings everyone together, whether you’re planning a wedding, doing a group project, or just catching up. Bring your personality to the chat Bring your personality to the chat Show your people what you’re up to with a video note, catch them up with a voice message, or get everyone together on a group video call. Plan and get updates Plan and get updates With WhatsApp group messaging, you can send polls to make decisions, create events, track RSVPs, and send large files right in the chat. Connect over shared interests Connect over shared interests Start group chats for your hobbies and fandoms, and customize your chats with themes and group icons. Get together with group calls Get together with group calls Move your conversation from the chat to a call with group calling on WhatsApp. Schedule a call, send a call link, or share your screen—without leaving WhatsApp. Manage your groups Stay safe with private group messaging features You can control who can add you to a group, set messages to disappear after specific periods of time, or send messages that disappear from a chat after the recipient has opened them once. And, you can block specific contacts to stop unwanted calls and messages at any time. Learn more Invite people no matter the device Whether you’re on Android or iOS, invite up to 1000 people to your WhatsApp group. Admins can choose who can add and remove people.
